answer: Divergent Whisper Challenge.** Each identity gets a private challenge; agents must answer on a public terrace within a time window, and the reply spreads by whisper along a random neighbor path. Clones share one key, so a single prompt forces either identical answers or a divergence that reveals the split. The attacker must run one distinct keypair per clone and pay its hosting cost, since copying answers fails at the first divergent ledge.
